origin.description: S3 generic for the DESCRIPTION fields that record where a package came from.
origin.usage: remote_metadata(x, bundle = NULL, source = NULL, sha = NULL)

arguments.name: bundle
arguments.text: Path to a downloaded archive. Default NULL. The GitHub method reads the commit SHA from the archive when this is set.

arguments.name: source
arguments.text: Unpacked source directory. Default NULL. The local and GitHub methods do not read it.

arguments.name: sha
arguments.text: SHA to store when bundle is NULL. Default NULL. A length-1 NA becomes NULL.

origin.details: A local remote returns RemoteType local, RemoteUrl equal to the normalized path, and RemoteSubdir. A GitHub remote returns the Remote* fields and the backward-compatible Github* fields from install-github.R. An explicit sha is stored on RemoteSha and GithubSHA1.
origin.value: A named list of DESCRIPTION fields. Missing fields are NULL.
origin.example:
path <- tempfile()
dir.create(path)
writeLines(c("Package: foo", "Version: 1.0.0"), file.path(path, "DESCRIPTION"))
meta <- remotes:::remote_metadata(remotes:::local_remote(path))
stopifnot(identical(meta$RemoteType, "local"), identical(meta$RemoteUrl, normalizePath(path)))
cat("remote_metadata on a local directory returns RemoteType local and RemoteUrl equal to normalizePath.\n")

translation.description: S3 generic for the DESCRIPTION fields that record where a package came from.

arguments.name: bundle
arguments.text: Path to a downloaded archive. Default None. The GitHub method reads the pax comment SHA when this is set.

arguments.name: source
arguments.text: Unpacked source directory. Default None. It is not read.

arguments.name: sha
arguments.text: SHA to store when bundle is None. Default None. None is the NA_character_ that the GitHub method stores as NULL.

translation.details: A local remote returns RemoteType local, RemoteUrl equal to normalizePath of the path passed to local_remote, and RemoteSubdir. A GitHub remote with an explicit sha returns RemoteType, RemoteHost, RemotePackage, RemoteRepo, RemoteUsername, RemoteRef, RemoteSha, RemoteSubdir, GithubRepo, GithubUsername, GithubRef, GithubSHA1, and GithubSubdir. RemoteSha and GithubSHA1 are that sha.
translation.value: A dict of DESCRIPTION fields. Missing fields are None.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from remotes.remote import local_remote, remote_metadata
path = tempfile.mkdtemp()
with open(os.path.join(path, "DESCRIPTION"), "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as handle:
    handle.write("Package: foo\nVersion: 1.0.0\n")
meta = remote_metadata(local_remote(path))
assert meta["RemoteType"] == "local" and meta["RemoteUrl"] == os.path.realpath(path)
print("remote_metadata on a local directory returns RemoteType local and RemoteUrl equal to normalizePath.")
